notes: Figure 3/4 (overall-obesity prevalence by age, paneled by birth cohort, stratified by education level, smoothed with LOESS). FIG34 is a representative subset (cohorts 1-2, men, overall-obesity series) of the author's own age-standardized prevalence estimates, embedded inline in the original script. The reshape DATA step and PROC SGPANEL/LOESS call are copied verbatim except ROWAXIS's LABELPOS=top is dropped (not a documented ROWAXIS/COLAXIS option in PROC SGPANEL -- LABELPOS is valid on PROC SGPLOT's XAXIS/YAXIS but not here). The upstream PROC SURVEYFREQ step that produces these estimates from the private KNHANES extract is omitted.
